_comment: MTG_EDF_CAST_ORDER (part 1 of the USER-approved EDF cast-order package, 2026-10-14; docs/design/edf-cast-order-2026-10-14.md). Four mana: Yavimaya Coast + Wild Growth (2), Kitchen (1), Adarkar Wastes (1); Eldrazi Displacer and Essence Depleter in play; hand [Peregrine Drake, Cloud of Faeries] -- DRAKE FIRST in hand order. {Cloud, Drake} pays only Cloud-first: under the tap-ahead Cloud nets +1 off the Aura'd land (5 mana), then the Drake resolves; the Drake loop nets +1 per blink against the {2}{C} Displacer, where Cloud's alone nets 0. The two untappers used to TIE at rank 5, hand order decided, and the walk priced the Drake first (4 of its 5), dropping the only T4 kill at every budget. Cheapest untapper first (Cloud 3, Drake 5) finds it whatever the hand order. The probe this came from: build/scratch/castorder/probe_EldraziDisplacerFlicker/t4_drake_first.json (base ff3e205b: no win).
